title: Vijayanagar Dynasties Suluva
definition: The Saluva Dynasty (1485–1505 CE) was the second ruling house of the Vijayanagara Empire, established by Saluva Narasimha Deva Raya following the decline of the Sangama dynasty.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for understanding the transition of power in medieval South India, the rise of military commanders (Nayakas), and the stabilization of the empire against Bahmani and Gajapati threats.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Vijayanagar Dynasties Suluva.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
